rows.v: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, fear elevated.
QQQ has lagged SPY by 3.0 points over 20 sessions. Tech is the weak spot; the broad market is holding up better.
The decision is unchanged from the Nov 19 note: stand aside. Since then, SPY fell 3.64% and QQQ fell 5.67%, and both closed below the Nov 19 closes that now mark their 1-month lows.
Toward selective: a QQQ close above 682.07, its 200-day average and the market gate. Toward lean in: a QQQ close above 710.88, its 50-day average, which would pass the pipeline's market check.
